# Molly Fletcher

> > Molly Fletcher is a keynote speaker, leadership expert, and former sports agent who helps Fortune 500 companies unlock peak performance through proven coaching methodologies and personal development strategies.

Molly Fletcher combines her background as a sports agent and negotiation expert with modern leadership coaching to serve corporate clients. Her platform includes keynote speaking, a podcast, online courses, and an exclusive women's leadership accelerator program.

## Key Topics

- Peak Performance

- Game Changers Podcast
- Sports Agent Background

- Business Coaching
- Professional Development
- The Energy Clock
